### Bible Pathways - Feb. 25, 2009
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-feb-25-2009-11599978.html
Passage: Numbers 29:1
Points:
- The Feast of Trumpets called God's people to set aside earthly labor and assemble before the Lord in sacred worship.
- Trumpets sounded continuously throughout the day rather than merely at the moments of sacrifice.
- Even during festive thanksgiving, regular sacrifices and sin offerings remained essential to make atonement.
- The long summer gap between Pentecost and Trumpets foreshadows the church age awaiting Christ's return.
